blocks.task_summary: Given a spherical bubble with volume increasing at a constant rate of 5 cm³ s⁻¹ and initial volume zero, find the rate at which the radius increases when the volume is 20 cm³.
method_path: Solve V = (4/3)πr³ for r when V = 20 to obtain r = (15/π)^(1/3)
Differentiate V with respect to r: dV/dr = 4πr²
Apply the chain rule: dV/dt = dV/dr × dr/dt (or equivalently dr/dt = dr/dV × dV/dt)
Substitute dV/dt = 5 and the computed r value to find dr/dt = 5/(4π(15/π)^(2/3)) ≈ 0.140 cm s⁻¹
